title: A detached worker killed during its startup confirmation leaves a summary that does not say no stage ran
outcome: When a detached run's worker exits (an OS kill or a fatal runtime error) during its startup confirmation, before it can save a failure, the run's refusal and later summary say that no stage ran and why, instead of only the close status and UNKNOWN.
acceptance: A detached worker killed during its startup confirmation leaves a summary that does not say no stage ran is done
